computation_tools.name: compute_coverage_summary
computation_tools.description: Per-sector and per-USID RSRP statistics plus area-level SINR, throughput, and RSRQ distributions across all pixels. Cached after first call.

computation_tools.name: compute_capacity_summary
computation_tools.description: Capacity score for every USID from site attributes CSV. Formula: (4G_cells x 1.0 + 5G_cells x 2.0) x (1 + 0.15 x active_bands). Used as input to compute_load_redistribution. Cached after first call.

computation_tools.name: identify_neighbors
computation_tools.description: Rank all USIDs by backup overlap fraction with the target USID. Returns list sorted by overlap fraction descending. Cached by target_usid after first call.

computation_tools.name: compute_load_redistribution
computation_tools.description: When target_usid goes down, compute absorption capacity and overload risk for each backup USID. Internally calls compute_capacity_summary — no need to pass it separately. Cached by target_usid after first call.

computation_tools.name: generate_rsrp_image
computation_tools.description: RSRP heatmap PNG for a given USID. Returns image_path and cached flag. Skips generation if file already exists.

computation_tools.name: generate_sinr_map
computation_tools.description: SINR heatmap PNG with target USID dominant area boundary. Returns image_path and cached flag. Skips generation if file already exists.

computation_tools.name: generate_throughput_map
computation_tools.description: Throughput heatmap PNG with target USID dominant area boundary. Returns image_path and cached flag. Skips generation if file already exists.

computation_tools.name: generate_rsrq_map
computation_tools.description: RSRQ heatmap PNG with target USID dominant area boundary. Returns image_path and cached flag. Skips generation if file already exists.

computation_tools.name: generate_dominance_map
computation_tools.description: Dominance map PNGs: full network overview and neighborhood zoom. Returns overview_path, neighborhood_path, and cached flag. Skips generation if both files already exist.
